text:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — Helianth POC approved. Procurement sent PO with multiple redlines: KMS custody, SLA, and they want countersign before we provision. Need quick sync.
Diego (Finance): They requested NET45 and pre-authorized credit hold for the POC. Do we accept NET45? That will require approval.
Maya (AE): They also asked for a one-time credit: 10% off the POC fees (approx $4k). Can finance pre-approve a promotional credit?
Tom (Legal): I skimmed their redline. They lowered our liability cap and added a clause requiring HSM-backed key custody proof. We can accept an attestation for customer-managed KMS but not transfer of keys or third-party custody on our side.
Priya (Security): We need SOC2 report and latest pen test summary. For KMS: customer can provide a KMS resource ARN + temp credentials to run a validation encrypt/decrypt. We can provide a simple validation script. Note: if they require HSM attestation, ask for vendor certs.
Evan (SRE): Operationally: private instance requires signed order form, PO, and onboarding checklist. If customer-managed KMS, expect an extra 48 hours for IAM mapping and validation. Provisioning lead time: estimated 4 business days post-complete paperwork.
Diego (Finance): NET45 is longer than standard. Finance can accept NET45 for named enterprise accounts with approval from Revenue Ops. I'll start approval but flag that our standard is NET30.
Maya (AE): Regarding signature flow, Helianth insists that their legal sign first then ours. That complicates our counter-sign process — prefer AE sign then customer then Redwood legal. Thoughts?
Tom (Legal): Standard approach: send DocuSign with signing order we control to ensure final countersign is by Redwood legal. If they insist on customer-first, request an explicit e-sign audit trail and ensure their signature is binding. We should request the counterparty include a signature block for Redwood to execute last.
docusign-bot: Envelope created: draft order form attached (link).
Priya (Security): Data residency note: they want EU data residency for training data. For POC we can host in eu-west-1; must specify in order form. Also add an export control clause — they requested no model export to certain jurisdictions.
Evan (SRE): KMS validation snippet to send to customer:```aws kms encrypt --key-id <KMS_ARN> --plaintext "redwood-validation" --output text```
Evan (SRE): If they provide a customer-managed KMS we will require an IAM role with kms:Encrypt permissions scoped to the key for validation. Add this to onboarding checklist.
Tom (Legal): SLA concern: they requested 99.995% for the trial. For POC we should offer 99.9% with credits capped at the POC fees. I'll propose tracked change language and a note about not offering remission for proof-of-concept phases.
Diego (Finance): Promo credit of 10% OK if SalesOps approves. I'll open a concession ticket. NET45 needs Revenue Ops sign-off.
Maya (AE): Action items: 1) @Tom draft legal reply accepting KMS attestation + propose 99.9% POC SLA; 2) @Diego put concession ticket for 10% credit and start NET45 approval; 3) @Evan post onboarding checklist and KMS validation command; 4) I'll request Helianth to use exact billing legal name and provide W-9 equivalent for vendor setup.
Tom (Legal): Will draft and post reply with redline snippet. Prefer DocuSign order: Signing order we want: 1) Helianth AE (acknowledge PO) 2) Helianth Legal (sign) 3) Redwood Legal (final). This preserves audit trail.
Diego (Finance): I'll confirm once concessions ticket is created. Please ask customer to include remit-to details exactly as on their vendor form to avoid delays.
Evan (SRE): Onboarding timeline: 1 business day after signed PO + order form + KMS attestation to start setup, 3 business days to complete provisioning (assuming approvals). If KMS requires vendor integration, add 2 more days.
Maya (AE): I'll hold provisioning until DocuSign is complete and legal thumbs up. I'll send a consolidated email with timeline and required artifacts.
Helianth (external): thanks, we'll return PO and KMS ARN by EOD tomorrow and confirm billing.
Maya (AE): Great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up tomorrow AM if we haven't received docs. :pray:
